note: Nested instance IDs now parse and round-trip through encoded Figma and bridge URLs, enabling an asset-only export of an instance descendant. Asset exports retain the real lookup/render exception, node type, elapsed time and bounded native/fallback stage diagnostics; deterministic renderer failures are no longer advertised as retryable and failed manifests omit path/outputPath. DEVUP_ASSET_TIMEOUT_MS configures a bounded per-asset lookup/render budget (default 90000 ms, range 1000–600000), also carried through export fragment reads; polling reports elapsed time on running calls. A hung SVG renderer leaves time for a read-only fallback using the requested subtree's actual rendered fill geometry, centered stroke outlines, colors, opacity, winding rules and transforms. Unsupported masks, clipping, gradients, effects, text, non-center/dashed strokes and ambiguous bounds fail explicitly rather than changing the picture; native export and normal PNG/PDF assets stay unchanged. Fragment re-exports use the same fallback and preserve its original failure evidence. Rebuild and reopen the plugin bundle, and update the bridge host, to enable the new script and timeout behavior. Instance snapshots additionally collect async main-component identity and preserve lookup errors for shared-component review. Live Prime SVG, PNG at scale 2 and PDF exports were byte-identical before/after the server change; the historical repeated renderer failure did not recur in this session and its cause remains unproven.
